policies.notes: Ticket PRs target integration and require independent review plus fresh CI. Only Jon release-merges integration into main. Review policy holds unreviewed PRs; an independent agent review is not an owner listening or license act. T01 is the pre-specified broad foundation ticket; package scaffolding, gates and generated registry/mission files are reviewed together. Later feature changes retain small ticket boundaries. November 6 owner amendment authorizes integration squash merges after green current-head CI and independent current-base review. November 7 owner decision (docs/research/OWNER-DECISIONS-2026-11-07.md): the repository is public for the build so hosted CI stays free, and returns to private at production level (Jon's call). Server-side rulesets now enforce PR-only changes, the three foundation checks, an up-to-date branch and squash merging on integration, and PR-only changes with the same checks on main. Independent review, owner-only release of main and no auto-merge stay procedural. A review is bound to the PR's patch (git patch-id --stable): a clean integration-only update keeps it, any other change needs a fresh review; this is the lead's addendum and awaits Jon's confirmation. Main remains owner-release-only. Merged code is distinct from pending full acceptance.
